method: Deterministic data-driven linking. Tokens from name+primaryKeyword+secondaryKeywords (lowercased, stopwords removed, light stemming). Score = sum(IDF of shared stems) + 40 same-category + 6 same-toolType + 5 same-category&toolType bonus + documented cross-category workflow adjacency bonus (10-15, only when >=1 shared stem). The modest same-category bonus lets strong cross-category keyword overlap outrank weak same-category pairs. Each tool keeps its top 8 by score (tie-break: toolId asc), floored at 3 via score-ordered fallback. Bidirectional pass: if A->B but not B->A, B gains the reverse link (append if capacity, else replace B's weakest non-mutual link when the reverse score beats it; never breaks mutual pairs). Remaining one-directional pairs are recorded as exceptions. No popularity scores, no randomness, no self-links.
